title: Lyrical I–vi–IV–V loop for singing sections
summary: Softer rhythmic orchestras (Troilo, Tanturi) support more lyrical progression families such as I–vi–IV–V in major or i–VI–III–V7 in minor, giving melodic phrases room to breathe.
engine_hint: progression_character=lyrical; pair with lower marcato density and higher ornament allowance on Render.
